decision_description: The Phase 7 budget gate assessment at docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/budget_gate_assessment.json declares gate_pass_declaration 'pass'. It grounds that pass on a budget source named budget_response_FICTIONAL_demo_2026-10-01.json, whose figures are explicitly labelled fictional and were not produced by the external Lump Sum Budget Planner (produced_by_external_planner: false). All wp_coverage_results (WP1-WP7) and partner_coverage_results (P01-P12) resolve their figures to that fictional response. For a lump-sum instrument, a budget figure from a source so named is an invented budget figure. The constitutional-compliance-check skill flagged this as a §13.3 violation at critical severity. This entry records that violation as a durable Tier 4 decision requiring human operator resolution.
rationale: Per CLAUDE.md §9.4 and §13.5, a detected constitutional violation that affects future interpretation, traceability, and reproducibility must be written to the Tier 4 decision log and not held only in agent memory. The violation is recorded as unresolved because resolution requires a human operator to confirm or reject any in-session §1 override suspending §13.3; no such override is present in this skill's context and none may be assumed. Until that confirmation, the gate pass rests on a fabricated budget source contrary to §8.3 and §17.6.7.
